lines.zh: 雾很薄，我的脚不发出声音。
lines.en: The fog is thin and my feet make no sound.

lines.zh: 我在你身后二十格走着。
lines.en: I walk twenty blocks behind you.
A branch snapped, and it was not me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，跟着你的火把。
lines.en: Step by step I follow your torch.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经不在那了。
lines.en: When you turn, I am no longer there.
The fog hugs the ground; I hug the fog.
I cross the grass without bending it.
Deep in the trees I close the distance.

lines.zh: 你鞋底的声音，我听了整晚。
lines.en: I have listened to your boots all night.
The moon sinks lower; I keep walking.
I do not run; running would frighten you.
A little closer, and that is close enough.
I stand in the fog and do not move.

lines.zh: 很远的地方有狗叫，我等着。
lines.en: A dog barks far off; I wait.

lines.zh: 你屋子那扇窗还透着光。
lines.en: A light still shows in that window of yours.

lines.zh: 我把手垂着，像一根枯木。
lines.en: I let my arms hang like dead wood.
The night is this quiet; good.
I count the panes of your window.

lines.zh: 风把雾吹开，我又站回去。
lines.en: The wind parts the fog and I step back in.

lines.zh: 有人从路上过了，我低下眼。
lines.en: Someone walked the road; I lowered my eyes.
Dawn is near; I have to go.
This night is long; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我看见你举着火把往这边看。
lines.en: I see you raise a torch and look this way.

lines.zh: 你没有看见我，可我在看。
lines.en: You do not see me, but I am watching.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛扫过雾，停了一下。
lines.en: Your eyes sweep the fog and pause.
I am only a few trees from you.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的节奏我听得清。
lines.en: Your breathing keeps a rhythm I can follow.
Do not stare into the fog too long.
My face is in the fog, unclear.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我也退了一步。
lines.en: You step back and so do I.
You have seen these eyes in dreams.
I watch you, and not out of curiosity.
One more step and I stop hiding.

lines.zh: 火把照不到我站的地方。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach where I stand.
I have watched you since the sun went down.
You hit me; that is rare.

lines.zh: 疼不是问题，问题是你在哪。
lines.en: Pain is not the problem; your whereabouts are.
That sword made me give half a step.
What I bleed, you cannot see clearly.
Your sword hand will not stop shaking.
Cut me again and I will remember you.
Knocked back, I will come again.
Did you hear the sound I made?
This body does not fear pain.

lines.zh: 你赢了这一下，不是这一夜。
lines.en: You won that blow, not the night.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我不吃这个。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I do not eat that.
Bread cannot tempt a thing like me.

lines.zh: 你把肉丢在地上，我看了一眼。
lines.en: You drop meat; I glance at it once.
I am hungry, but not for that.

lines.zh: 你招手的姿势，我学不会。
lines.en: I cannot learn that beckoning gesture.

lines.zh: 我只想要你手里的火把。
lines.en: I only want the torch in your hand.
Set it closer and I will step on it.

lines.zh: 你在跟谁说话，我不是狗。
lines.en: Who are you talking to? I am not a dog.
Save that bait for yourself.
Your hand is reaching too far.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，才看见我。
lines.en: You walk into me before you see me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀穿过了我的袖子。
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through my sleeve.
Do not touch me; my hands are cold.

lines.zh: 你退开时踩到了我的脚。
lines.en: You step on my foot as you pull away.
This close, and you still think of running?
The fog parts where you hit it, then closes.

lines.zh: 你的火把烫到了我的衣角。
lines.en: Your torch scorches the hem of my coat.
I stand firm; you cannot move me.
I am blocking the way behind you.

lines.zh: 我们擦肩，你什么也没看见。
lines.en: We pass shoulder to shoulder; you see nothing.
There is no one else in the fog but me.
There is no companion for the likes of me.

lines.zh: 你替我数着夜，也算陪着。
lines.en: Counting the nights for me counts as company.

lines.zh: 雾散的时候，我谁也没有。
lines.en: When the fog clears, I have no one.

lines.zh: 夜里只有影子挨着影子。
lines.en: At night only shadows lean on shadows.
I do not need another pair of hands.
I walk this road alone.
Will you stay and keep me company?
The fog is the only kin I have.
At dawn I am alone again.

lines.zh: 你落下的东西，在我手里。
lines.en: What you let fall is in my hand.

lines.zh: 这东西上全是你的味道。
lines.en: This thing is covered in your scent.
I set it back at your door.
There is cloth on the ground; I take it.
Your pickaxe is frighteningly heavy.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，但我要留着。
lines.en: I do not need it, but I will keep it.

lines.zh: 这块面包我会放在窗台上。
lines.en: I will leave this bread on your sill.

lines.zh: 你丢下的火把，我踩灭了。
lines.en: I put out the torch you dropped.

lines.zh: 捡东西的样子，你看见了。
lines.en: You saw me picking it up.
I do not touch what belongs to others.
Only when you are far do I start after you.

lines.zh: 你身后三十步，我加快脚步。
lines.en: Thirty paces behind you, I quicken.
The fog thickens and I need not hide.
Your name will not fit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你听见的呼吸声，是我的。
lines.en: That breathing you hear belongs to me.
From this moment, all you can do is run.
I stop trailing you from a distance.
Your door bolt will not stop me.
Tonight I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 雾往你那边涌，是跟着我。
lines.en: The fog rolls your way because I lead it.
You looked back; then let us begin.
I have seen your face now.
Run; I can chase longer than you.
Four hundred ticks or more will do.

lines.zh: 火光扫过来，我退进雾里。
lines.en: The torchlight sweeps past; I step back into the fog.

lines.zh: 你的脚步停了，我就知道你怕了。
lines.en: Your steps stopped. Now I know you're afraid.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，你没有听见。
lines.en: I move along the wall and you hear nothing.
You count heartbeats; I count them too.
This wall is a road to me.
I climb up to your window.

lines.zh: 屋里的灯暗下来了，我看见了。
lines.en: The lamp dims inside; I see it.
You hide in a mine; I follow down.
Darkness spreads around your feet.
I do not shout; shouting would spoil it.
You stop; I stop and let you breathe.

lines.zh: 墙角的阴影是我让开的。
lines.en: That shadow in the corner is where I stood.
Your torch went out; perfect.
Run on; your legs will fail before mine.
I am right behind you, one step off.

lines.zh: 你听见木头响了，那是我的脚。
lines.en: You heard wood creak; that was my foot.
The fog walks with me. You can't shake it.
I'm behind you, in no hurry to catch up.

lines.zh: 你的门开着一条缝，我看见了。
lines.en: Your door is open a crack. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，你的路只有一条。
lines.en: I needn't run. You have only one road.

lines.zh: 你数到十，我就到你身边。
lines.en: Count to ten and I'll be beside you.

lines.zh: 雾太浓，你找不到回头的路。
lines.en: The fog's too thick. You won't find the way back.
My hand closes on your shoulder.
You are pinned to the wall and cannot move.
You will remember this one.
Your blood drips into the fog.
I am in no hurry; one blow is enough.
You raise your sword, far too late.
My knuckles land against your chest.
When you scream, it sounds very small.
The fog has swallowed half of you.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就上前一步。
lines.en: Every step you surrender, I claim.
Do not shut your eyes; look at me.
Your night ends here.
My strikes are not heavy, just steady.
You fall, and the fog has not cleared.

lines.zh: 我的手很冷，你的脖子很热。
lines.en: My hands are cold. Your neck is warm.

lines.zh: 雾灌进你喉咙，我按住不放。
lines.en: Fog fills your throat; I hold you down.

lines.zh: 你挣扎了一下，然后安静了。
lines.en: You struggle once, then go quiet.

lines.zh: 我把你按进雾里，听你数数。
lines.en: I press you into the fog and listen to you count.
Your sword drops. The sound is very small.

lines.zh: 我不看你倒下的样子，我走了。
lines.en: I don't watch you fall. I leave.

lines.zh: 雾先浓起来，然后我才出现。
lines.en: The fog thickens first, then I appear.
Only once it is fully dark do I come out.

lines.zh: 你在夜里走路，我就有了理由。
lines.en: You walk at night, and I have my reason.
This place is remote enough; suitable.
I settle at the edge of your sight.
The moon lights the fog and lights me.
You lit a torch, so I came.

lines.zh: 白天我从不在，现在可以了。
lines.en: I am never here by day; now it is allowed.

lines.zh: 这三十格里，我随时能走。
lines.en: Within thirty blocks I can leave whenever I choose.

lines.zh: 你听见雾里有脚步，别回头。
lines.en: If you hear steps in the fog, do not turn.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，狗都不叫。
lines.en: When I appear, even the dogs fall silent.
The night is long; I came out to walk.
I have come from the far side of the woods.
I have found your camp.
The torchlight pushes me back.

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下来，落地无声。
lines.en: I drop from the wall without a sound.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的脸，我还在看你。
lines.en: Water covers my face; I still watch you.
The blast lights up the whole fog bank.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，你射得不错。
lines.en: The arrow is in me; good shot.

lines.zh: 你的咒语在我身上散了。
lines.en: Your spell comes apart on me.
Hunger means nothing to me.
Lightning showed me, for one instant.
No fog here, and no you.
